Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.badge: Current version {version} · draft pending legal review
Terms.lead: These rules apply to everyone who uses Hindama. By creating your account, and before your first project, you confirm that you accept them.
Terms.noteText: You may only test APIs you own or have written authorization to test. If you can't prove it, don't use Hindama on that API.

service.title: Purpose of the service
service.text: Hindama runs automated security tests on REST APIs based on their OpenAPI 3 contract and on the access policy declared by their owner.

responsible.title: Responsible use
responsible.text: You may only register and test APIs you own or for which you hold written authorization from their owner. Testing third-party APIs without authorization is prohibited and may be a crime.

ownership.title: Ownership verification
ownership.text: Before any test you must prove that you control the API's domain. The verification is checked again before every run.

limits.title: Limits and test environment
limits.text: We recommend using a test environment. The rate, concurrency, volume and duration limits you configure are respected at all times.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.text: Sensitive actions, such as creating projects, launching runs or accepting risks, are recorded in a log that cannot be altered.

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.text: We may suspend accounts that breach these terms and keep the information needed to answer requests from authorities.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.badge: Draft pending legal review · version 1.0 · 30 Oct 2026
Privacy.lead: How we handle your personal data under Mexico's Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties.

data.title: Data we collect
data.text: Name, email address and activity records of your account. From your projects we store the contract, the test identities with encrypted credentials and the results of the runs.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: To operate the platform, run the tests you request, generate reports and keep the service secure. We do not sell or share your data for commercial purposes.

credentials.title: Test credentials
credentials.text: They are stored encrypted and never shown in full: only their last 4 characters. In evidence and reports they appear masked.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.text: When you delete a project or your account, the data is deleted from the database immediately. Backups overwrite it within 7 days and, at most, 30. The audit log is kept for 6 months.

audit.title: Log and anonymous metrics
audit.text: The log records what action happened and when, with an internal user identifier and a host fingerprint, never passwords or free text. Usage metrics are anonymous, are not personal data and are kept even if you delete your account.

rights.title: ARCO rights
rights.text: You exercise cancellation yourself by deleting your account from Profile. To access your data, correct it or object to its processing, write to the team's email: privacidad@hindama.mx. We respond within 20 business days at most.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.text: We will publish any change on this page with its version date.

Home.meta: Hindama · Assess your API before you publish it
Home.badge: For teams that publish REST APIs
Home.title: Find your API's flaws before someone else does
Home.lead: Hindama tests your API's security from its OpenAPI 3 contract and from who should be able to do what. Every flaw comes with the request that reproduces it and stays with you until you fix it.
